content.text:
TASK:
Record the UPDATE MEMBER INFORMATION capability against MERIDIAN CORE. (1) Sign on. (2) Member Inquiry -> search by Member Number for the memberId parameter -> Select. (3) Click 'Update Member Information'. (4) Type the email parameter into the E-mail field, the phone parameter into Phone, and the address parameter into Mailing Address. (5) Click 'Save Changes' - this modifies the member record, so mark it irreversible=true (a human pre-authorised this recording). (6) On the confirmation screen use read ONCE to capture the confirmation line into an output named 'confirmation' - target the value cell next to its label, and do NOT target the member's name, e-mail, phone or address. (7) Do NOT declare_outcome for the success case: success is already expressed by the step's own checkpoint, and a terminal outcome that fires on the success screen would be dead weight. Only declare_outcome if you deliberately probe a FAILURE state. (8) declare_done with capability_id 'member.updateInfo'.

PARAMETERS:
- memberId (internal): Caller-supplied parameter 'memberId'. — value: "103001"
- email (pii): Caller-supplied parameter 'email'. — value: (secret — reference with param, never typed literally)
- phone (pii): Caller-supplied parameter 'phone'. — value: (secret — reference with param, never typed literally)
- address (pii): Caller-supplied parameter 'address'. — value: (secret — reference with param, never typed literally)
- operatorId (internal): Resolved from the environment (MERIDIAN_OPERATOR_ID) at invocation time; never stored in the artifact. — value: "teller1"
- operatorPassword (secret): Resolved from the environment (MERIDIAN_OPERATOR_PASSWORD) at invocation time; never stored in the artifact. — value: (secret — reference with param, never typed literally)

The application is served at https://web-sample.interface-hiring.com. The browser is currently blank — begin by navigating to the application.

input.intent: Open the MERIDIAN CORE application to begin sign on.

input.title: Update Member Information
input.description: Signs on to MERIDIAN CORE, opens Member Inquiry, searches by Member Number for the 'memberId' parameter and selects the member, then opens 'Update Member Information' and writes the 'email', 'phone', and 'address' parameters into the E-mail, Phone, and Mailing Address fields. Clicking 'Save Changes' commits the member-record change (irreversible). On the resulting confirmation screen it captures the success confirmation indicator into output 'confirmation' (value "MEMBER INFORMATION UPDATED"). Note: the detailed confirmation sentence renders as plain non-semantic text and is not exposed as an addressable element, so the addressable success heading is used as the confirmation value. Inputs: memberId, email, phone, address, operatorId, operatorPassword.
